data.name: UnsupportedSchema
data.value: The {0} at '{1}' is schema {2}, but this build requires exactly schema {3}. This store cannot be upgraded by this build. Copy '{1}' somewhere safe first; only then delete it and let Motif recreate it.

data.name: OlderStore
data.value: The {0} at '{1}' is schema {2}, and this build uses schema {3}. Motif upgrades it on a normal open, after backing it up first, not in this read-only view. Open the project in Motif, or run `motif store upgrade --project <project>`, or upgrade a copy with `motif store upgrade --source <old.db> --out <new.db>`. Do not delete the store.

data.name: ResetBackupFailed
data.value: Motif could not back up the project store '{0}' before resetting it, so it deleted nothing. {1}

data.name: UpgradeFailedNoBackup
data.value: Motif could not back up the project store '{0}' before upgrading it from schema {1} to {2}, so it did not upgrade it and changed nothing. {3}

data.name: UpgradeFailedBuild
data.value: Motif could not upgrade the project store '{0}' from schema {1} to {2}. The store was not changed. A backup taken first is at '{3}'; `motif store restore` puts it back. {4}

data.name: UpgradeFailedSwap
data.value: Motif could not finish moving the upgraded project store '{0}' (schema {1} to {2}) into place. Opening the project again finishes it. A backup taken first is at '{3}'; `motif store restore` puts the store back as it was. {4}
